entityDescription:
DVOKUT-ECRO Ltd. is a service provider in the field of environmental and nature protection, based in Zagreb. We are a privately held company, originally established in 1991, and have been operating under the current name since 1995.
DVOKUT-ECRO is a renowned company with extensive experience in Croatia and the wider region: Albania, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Bulgaria, Montenegro, Hungary, North Macedonia, Slovenia, Serbia, Kosovo, Turkey, and Ukraine.

The expertise of our employees and our references have enabled us to obtain the licence to preform professional tasks related to the preparation of expert input documents, EIA Screening reports and EIA studies in 1997 by the competent authority at the time, the National Directorate for Environmental Protection. That same year, our modern air quality monitoring equipment, the Mobile Ecologic Laboratory, qualified us for a licence to perform professional tasks in monitoring air quality and emissions into the air, and other expert tasks related to monitoring. 
In the meantime, as the regulations changed, we have responded to the opportunity to expand our range of services and consequently obtained licences to perform other professional activities. Today, DVOKUT-ECRO holds 25 licences for providing services in environmental and nature protection. Additionally, we offer to our clients the preparation of feasibility studies, design documentation, due diligence audits and reports.
We have been continuously investing in our team of thirty experts, and in most advanced equipment. This allows us to consistently expand our areas of activity, develop and offer new services for our clients in both private and public sectors.

entityDescription:
Lympik products are developed for the ski sport, in order to offer competitive athletes in this area the possibility to measure and analyze all their trainings. This gives them the opportunity to increase their performance. In the field of timekeeping for sports, the obsolete, extensive and complicated radio technology is currently mainly used. Therefore, these products are hardly used for training, but almost only for competitions.
What makes our system so unique is the use of satellite technology for accurate determination of time and location and the IoT technology for the sensors. That's why our solution is simpler, more accurate, more flexible and less error-prone. In addition, our devices are much smaller and lightweight through the use of these technologies.
Furthermore, we offer operators of ski resorts fixed, digitized tracks that can be used by the masses. A solution for ski schools complete the offer.
We provide our customers live results and what´s more a direct connection to social media. Thus, we connect the digital world with the physical.

entityDescription:
The Bavarian Red Cross (BRK) is a regional branch of the German Red Cross (GRC) and part of a worldwide movement assisting victims of conflict and disaster and people affected by social or health related crisis. The fundamental principles of the Red Cross Movement are Humanity, Impartiality, Neutrality, Independence, Voluntary Service, Unity and Universality. The Bavarian Red Cross is integrated into the German Civil Protection System and partner within different national and international research projects. 
The Bavarian Red Cross (DE-BRK) is the largest charity and disaster relief organisation in Bavaria. In the field of ambulance services the (DE-BRK) provides about 80% of the services with more than 4.300 professional paramedics, 8 integrated command centres (emergency call number 112), 2 rescue helicopters and 320 Rescue Station. Furthermore, the BRC is active in several areas of essential welfare services. About 120.000 volunteers from all sectors of services, such as the Mountain Rescue, Water Rescue and the Youth Red Cross provide about 4 million hours of service a year. In addition, the Bavarian Red Cross is involved in the crisis management in the COVID-19 situation. The Bavarian Red Cross Headquarters in Munich coordinates the requests and shares the relevant Information between all NGO and GO`s.

For this reason, the HCU offers the entire range of disciplines required for understanding and designing the urban environment: - Architecture, Civil Engineering, Geomatics, Urban Planning – in each case as a Bachelor’s degree with the option to continue studying to obtain a Master’s degree;
- Metropolitan Culture – as a Bachelor programme;
- Urban Design and Ressource Efficiency in Architecture and Planning (REAP) – as interdisciplinary Master’s degrees;
- A cross-curricular programme, inter- and transdisciplinary, complements the curriculum of the individual study programms at HCU.

entityDescription: Munich-based automation specialist Cevotec offers one of the world’s most advanced production systems for complex fiber composites. The production systems enable the automated lay-up of carbon fibers, glass fibers, adhesive films and other technical fibers on complex 3D geometries. description: Pan Galactic Developments Ltd is a registered Limited company developing applications and blockchain for Space. Pan Galactic are specifically working in R&D to create a carbon negative blockchain using new consensus methods and their own pro-active environmental work. In addition to the network technology, Pan Galactic are also developing a suite of logistics and verification applications using blockchain and NFTs. Pan Galactic also provide a series of B2C applications to engage the imagination of everyday people to look to Space as a future destination to work, live, visit through DeFi applications and tokens, creating a viable and democratic Space currency system and decentralised exchange. Further work also includes working with a series of senior academics within the universities sector and leaders within the blockchain sector to develop useful solutions to a series of problems. Pan Galactic is already working with a number of Space colleagues on outreach on STEM education and Space with groups around the world.
entityDescription:
Pan Galactic Developments Ltd is a diverse UK Tech Start-up tasking itself with the development of future communicative Blockchain technologies for the Space industry which can also be applied on Earth.
Specifically Pan Galactic Developments is working to create a Blockchain network on which to host a series of our own native applications whilst providing our platform for others to use to contribute to solving commercial and logistical problems in Space. The Pan Galactic Blockchain being our biggest project to develop we also seek to create the first Space based blockchain which is Carbon Negative without sacrificing high performance speed and capacity.
In regards to our own native Space applications we are creating a series of logistics solutions to help Space Agencies and businesses to securely manage the full logistics journey, certification of provenance and tracking for items moving through the wider Space supply chain. We will also offer decentralised finance applications for use of Space Tourists and Residents to transact and make purchases within Space and the emerging space economy this will include non-custodial wallets applications and an optional digital currency system enabling users to make use of our native coin or other digital assets such as Central Bank issued Digital Currencies, Government Issued Digital Currencies and other Space related digital currencies giving the user the option of how to transact.
During the building phase of our Pan Galactic Blockchain technology we are working with Space partners on outreach and educational projects to inspire people to think about Space exploration and the future. entityDescription:
The Leibniz-Institut für Verbundwerkstoffe GmbH (IVW) is a nonprofit research institution of the state of Rhineland-Palatinate and the Technische Universität Kaiserslautern (TUK). It researches fundamentals for future applications of composite materials, which are of great importance for the mobility of the future, the fields of energy, climate and environment, production technology as well as for health care. New materials, construction methods and manufacturing processes are investigated and - after the basic understanding has been developed - tailor-made for the respective requirements.
The focus is on the entire process chain, from basic materials to characterization and simulation, from construction methods and production technology to component testing and recycling. New ideas and innovative concepts are not only an essential part of the research and further development of the institute, but also lead to spin-offs. Newly acquired knowledge is transferred, above all into science, but also into teaching, the interested public and industrial applications.
As a member of theLeibniz Association, the institute receives institutional grants in accordance with the AV-WGL for the joint financial support of institutions by the federal and state governments (federal share 50%, share of the state of Rhineland-Palatinate and the entirety of the states 50%).

entityDescription:
Greenwishes offers off-site waste management in our connected warehouse and a local 100% French recycling circuit. 
We begin by an implementation of selective sorting in your premises: papers, drinks, and other waste.
After, recyclable waste is collected in rolls according to a schedule that meets your needs. A roll is provided for each customer, each site and each collection. During the collection on site, the waste is identified thanks to a bar code.
Then, the waste is oversorted and gathered by homogeneous recyclable materials. Once processed by our sorting agents, the waste is compacted into bales (a format that is more suitable for transport and handling). 
We are able to weigh the waste to the nearest 200 grams per customer per day, by the agents after over-sorting, and to enter the data into the reporting system for each site.
Finally, the recycling and recovery of all waste is done France. We offer more than 30 French recycling partners for the treatment of your waste. The group has its own garbage truck to collect residual waste in case of collection incident.
